text:
zoe-ops: heads up — after the policy push at 11:02 UTC we're seeing a bunch of GPU nodes fail to pull keys during boot in eu-west-1. autoscaler couldn't attach new instances.
zoe-ops: sample error from node boot log: `ERROR: kms: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException`
matt-infra: I can confirm. provisioning logs show repeated 403s to KMS endpoint from private subnets. metrics: spike in Pending->Failed launches.
lina-sec: which change exactly? the firewall rule that tightened outbound to only specific CIDRs?
matt-infra: yeah PR #4526 restricted egress to 10.0.0.0/16 and privatelink endpoints only. we missed the managed KMS endpoint IPs (they're dynamic).
carl-sre: impact: warm pools not able to scale out, but autoscaler keeps retrying — so we have a backlog. Also some warm GPUs stayed up longer to compensate, cost spiked ~14% in the last 30m.
zoe-ops: keystore-bot alerted earlier: `ALERT: keystore-decrypt-error >= 5m in eu-west-1`
keystore-bot: Automated note: creating ticket INFRA-7892, samples attached.
lina-sec: short-term fix: allow outbound to the regional KMS endpoint via VPC endpoint or open 443 to AWS-managed IP ranges for KMS. prefer VPC endpoint.
matt-infra: can we create a KMS privatelink endpoint? I think KMS supports VPC endpoints (com.amazonaws.<region>.kms). provisioning script needs that route.
carl-sre: rolling rollback of the egress restriction would bring things back immediately. but that expands blast radius.
zoe-ops: suggestion: create VPC endpoint + add explicit SG to let instance role talk to it. then revert the egress tighten once endpoint is verified.
lina-sec: agree. create endpoint + add endpoint policy limiting principals to our account. security ok.
matt-infra: starting endpoint create now. i'll also add route and SG rule. ETA ~10m.
zoe-ops: while that's happening, can SRE increase retry/backoff on the provisioner so we don't hammer KMS causing more throttling?
carl-sre: yep toggled to 5s -> exponential with jitter in the provisioner, pushing config: `provisioner.retries=5; provisioner.backoff=exp+jitter`
keystore-bot: INFRA-7892 updated: remediation plan set.
matt-infra: endpoint created and associated with subnet-ids. updating instance SG to allow tcp:443 -> endpoint.
zoe-ops: tests show decrypt success from a fresh node now. provisioning healthy count starting to recover.
lina-sec: after stabilization we should add an automated preflight to flag egress rules that would block AWS-managed control planes (KMS, STS, S3 control). maybe a policy-as-code check.
carl-sre: opened ticket SRE-421 to add preflight to terraform plan.
zoe-ops: also let's add a cost guard: if failed provisioning causes warm pool hours > X in 30m, auto-notify and throttle warm pool.
matt-infra: logged COST-322.
lina-sec: postmortem action items: 1) revert risky egress rules without endpoint dependency 2) terraform preflight 3) endpoint creation template 4) provisioner retry improvements.
zoe-ops: thanks all — I'll keep the thread updated. :thumbsup:
keystore-bot: note: audit log entries for blocked KMS calls saved to s3://redwood-audit/eu-west-1/2359876543.log
